subject: Dedicated capacity — pricing & on-ramp options for HelioMetrics
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@heliometrics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity — pricing & on-ramp options for HelioMetrics

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, attached is a concise set of options for Dedicated GPU pool sizing, committed throughput, and term-level discounts — three routes we typically use depending on how comfortable the customer is with long-term commits vs. flexibility. Key points up front:

- All options include SLA-backed latency targets and a baseline 99.9% uptime for the Dedicated pool.
- We can set the capacity start date to align with your infra readiness; typical lead time is 6–10 weeks from signed contract.

Options (summary):
1) 12-month starter — 4xA100-equivalent GPUs (baseline pool), 200K tokens/day throughput guarantee, 10% off list, monthly billing. On-ramp: scale to target within 30 days.
2) 24-month standard — 8xA100-equivalent GPUs, 500K tokens/day guarantee, 18% off list, quarterly true-up, preferred queue routing. On-ramp: phased 60-day ramp to full capacity.
3) 36-month committed — 12xA100-equivalent GPUs, 1.2M tokens/day guarantee, 28% off list, upfront or monthly commit options, custom fallback policies. On-ramp: 90-day ramp with option to accelerate.

Attachments: proposed_pricing_heliometrics_v2.pdf (breaks down per-token economics, unit costs with/without KV caching, and sample ramp schedules).

Questions for you to confirm: preferred start window (June/July/Aug), and whether HelioMetrics prefers monthly true-up or fixed upfront billing. If you want, we can create a two-step proof-of-concept capacity reservation (smaller pool immediately, full pool on signed date) to shorten your ability to test latency under production load.

If this looks directionally right, I’ll loop in finance and legal and draft the SOW.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: proposed_pricing_heliometrics_v2.pdf (PDF, 132KB)]

From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@heliometrics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Cole <matt.cole@heliometrics.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — pricing & on-ramp options for HelioMetrics

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear options. A couple of clarifying items from our side before we move to a formal SOW:

1) For the 36-month committed option, HelioMetrics needs better economics if we lock that long — target is ~35% discount to make the TCO work vs our in-house baseline. Is there room to tighten?
2) Our desired capacity start date is earlier than the 6–10 week window if possible. Our engineering team can take a smaller initial pool in ~3 weeks to run integration tests; is a staged start acceptable and can you guarantee the throughput SLA on a staged ramp?
3) If our forecast (attached HLM_Q3_workload_forecast.csv) shows burst months, can we include a burst pool policy that caps overage at X% and bills on a blended rate?

Also cc’ing Matt (ops lead) — he’ll own the onboarding schedule.

Appreciate it —
Samantha Reed
Head of Data Platforms, HelioMetrics Inc.
[Attachment: HLM_Q3_workload_forecast.csv (CSV, 28KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@heliometrics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — pricing & on-ramp options for HelioMetrics

Samantha —

Appreciate the detail and the workload file; that helps a lot. Proposed counter that balances HelioMetrics’ need for economics and our ability to plan capacity:

A) 36-month path at 32% off list for a minimum 10xA100-equivalent pool (instead of 12x), with a guaranteed 1.0M tokens/day baseline and a documented ramp schedule. We’ll include a quarterly true-up and a capped burst policy (up to 40% burst above baseline billed at a reduced overage rate).

B) Staged start: we can provision a smaller 4x pool within 3 weeks for integration (no SLA on throughput until baseline is provisioned), and commit to bringing the baseline pool online within 90 days of signature — SLA applies once baseline is active. If you need SLA immediately on the 4x pool we can negotiate a short-term add-on.

C) Doc/contract mechanics: to reach the 32% discount we need a signed 36-month commit with either upfront payment or an approved monthly commitment via PO; finance prefers upfront or a 24/7 carve-out for credits.

If that addresses your asks, I’ll have a SOW draft and a DocuSign ready with the SOW and pricing. Copying Rishi and Priyom for operational/approval confirmation.

Best,
Jordan
[Attachment: none]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: HelioMetrics 36mo — margin & approval request

Team —

Quick internal note: HelioMetrics is asking for ~35% on a 36-month; I countered at 32% with a reduced pool (10x). Key risks: deep discount + early staged start increases variability on capacity utilization for the first two quarters. Things I need from you:

- Rishi: can we push 32% while maintaining the standard econ guardrails? Any constraints from Dedicated capacity planning (capacity start within 90 days + 4x staged start)?
- Priyom: legal/finance — confirmation that we can accept quarterly true-ups and a capped burst clause (40%) with blended overage rate. Also confirm preferred billing (upfront vs. PO).

I’ll keep public-facing email aligned to the 32% counter and the staged start concession. If you want a sliding scale where the discount increases to 34% at commit >12 months of actual utilization, we can propose that too.

— Jordan

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: HelioMetrics 36mo — margin & approval request

Jordan —

32% is tight but acceptable on the 10x pool with the following guardrails:
- Approve 32% if HelioMetrics signs a 36-month with an initial 10x (no more than 20% deviation in the first 2 quarters).
- Require a 30% non-refundable implementation fee on signature (applied to final invoice) to offset early provisioning risk.
- Approve the staged 4x pool for integration (no SLA) provided HelioMetrics signs the PO within 10 business days of staging.
- Approve capped burst at 40% with blended overage at 50% of published on-demand rate.

Priyom to confirm legal language, but finance is fine with monthly billing after the non-refundable fee unless they choose upfront prepay.

Rishi

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@heliometrics.com>
Cc: Matt Cole <matt.cole@heliometrics.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Final proposal & next steps — HelioMetrics Dedicated capacity

Samantha / Matt —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per internal approvals we’re prepared to move forward on the following commercial terms: 

- 36-month commitment at 32% off list for a 10x A100-equivalent Dedicated pool (baseline 1.0M tokens/day).
- Non-refundable implementation fee: 30% of first-year committed spend, payable on signature.
- Staged integration pool: 4x provisioned within 3 weeks of PO for testing (no SLA). Baseline pool to be brought online within 90 days of signature; SLAs begin at baseline activation.
- Burst policy: up to 40% above baseline billed at blended overage (50% of published on-demand rate).
- Quarterly true-ups and a standard SOW.

I’ve attached SOW draft (SOW_heliometrics_dedicated_v1.docx) and started a DocuSign envelope to capture the commitment + SOW. Please review and flag any redlines. If this looks good, confirm preferred start for staged 4x (we can do week of 6/29 or 7/6) and I’ll send the DocuSign link for signature.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/6789012

Next steps: HelioMetrics confirms staged start date + signs PO; Redwood provisions 4x pool; finalize baseline bring-up schedule.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_heliometrics_dedicated_v1.docx (DOCX, 48KB)]
